title: Data-Dense Admin Consoles & Real-Time Sync
summary: Build high-density operations dashboards, server-driven TanStack data tables, and real-time SSE sync engines.

problem.headline: Clunky Ops Tools & Admin Logic Leaks
points: Slow, unoptimized admin tables freezing under high row counts.
Inline UI toggles leaking admin routes and middleware into public client bundles.
Lack of real-time status updates forcing constant manual page refreshes.

approach.headline: Sandboxed Route Groups & Server-Driven Tables
points: Isolate admin consoles into dedicated route groups ((admin)) or standalone repositories.
Deploy server-driven TanStack Table pagination, sorting, and JSONB filtering.
Stream live status updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE) and log audit events.

deliverables: Sandboxed Operations Console with TanStack Table architecture
Append-only Operational Audit Log database schema & UI timeline
Query Optimization & Indexing Guide for high-row reporting
